name: agent-sessions
description: Lists each session's tasks, the answers to the user's questions, and the questions the agent asked the user under it in the Agent Sessions view of VS Code, and closes a finished session with what it delivered, its tickets and its cleanup.

interface.shortDescription: Tasks, answers, questions for you and a done mark under each session.
